text.p: Invacare Corp said Tuesday it had extended to March 24 its $13-a-share tender offer for Healthdyne Technologies. The offer was to have expired at midnight last night.
Invacare that as of February 24, some 2,018,145 shares of Healthdyne had been validly tendered under its offer.
Together with the 600,000 Healthdyne shares it already owns, Invacare said it now holds more than 20 percent of Healthdyne's outstanding common stock.
A. Malachi Mixon, chairman and chief executive officer of Invacare, reiterated that his company was interested in meeting with Healthdyne officials.

He said Invacare was prepared to discuss its offer price if Healthdyne could convince it of "additional values to our satisfaction, but only on terms that bring value to the shareholders" of both companies.
Mixon said that if Healthdyne decided to hold talks with potential acquirors, Invacare should be included.
